sections.title: NRN AND CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: COLD TROUGH OVER THE INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS MORNING IN THE PROCESS OF LIFTING NEWD WITH EXPECTED DEEPENING UPPER LOW INTO CENTRAL MT TONIGHT. ASSOCIATED 100 PLUS KT POLAR JET AZ-CO WILL SHIFT NEWD WITH THE TROUGH INTO CENTRAL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING AS STRONG COLD FRONT EMERGES FROM ROCKIES INTO HIGH PLAINS. WITH HIGH PRESSURE HOLDING OVER THE ERN US INTO NRN GULF...ONLY LIMITED GULF MOISTURE HAS BEEN ABLE TO RETURN IN THE STRONG SLY FLOW ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS. EVEN WITH STEEP LAPSE RATES TO 8C/KM DEVELOPING IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT...DEWPOINTS ONLY INTO THE 40S/LOW 50S WHILE RESULT IN MLCAPES NO HIGHER THAN 500 J/KG MUCH OF WARM SECTOR. WITH STRONG PRIMARILY UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW IN THE MARGINALLY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR...THE FORCING WITH THE COLD FRONT EXPECTED TO BE FOCUS FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. THE COMBINATION OF 40-50KT SFC-1KM SHEAR AND CONVECTIVE CONTRIBUTION FROM THE DEVELOPING LINE OF STORMS SHOULD LEAD TO A BAND OF STRONG/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS BY EARLY/MID AFTERNOON WRN DAKOTAS/WRN NEB/NERN CORNER CO. EMBEDDED MORE INTENSE SEGMENTS ARE POSSIBLE WITHIN THE SQUALL LINE BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON...INCREASING WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL AND EVEN THE PO

sections.title: SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: WITHIN A MORE SUBTLY FORCED LARGE SCALE REGIME...MODESTLY MOIST LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO ISOLATED STRONG/PERHAPS SEVERE STORMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF EASTERN NM AND FAR WEST/SOUTHWEST TX THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. SUFFICIENT VEERING COULD YIELD SOME SEMI-SUSTAINED STORMS/MARGINAL SUPERCELLS...WITH SEVERE HAIL AS THE PRIMARY CONCERN ON AN ISOLATED BASIS. ..HALES/JEWELL.. 04/13/2010

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/ND
sections.text: BKN BAND OF TSTMS CONTINUE TO EVOLVE/MOVE ENE ACROSS THE WRN DKTS/NEB AT MID-AFTN. CONVECTIVE MODE WILL LIKELY VACILLATE BETWEEN LINEAR-SEGMENTS AND BRIEF DISCRETE ENTITIES THROUGH LATE AFTN/EARLY EVE. HIGHER PROBABILITIES FOR LONGER-LIVED DISCRETE MODES WILL BE ACROSS ND WITHIN LEFT-EXIT REGION OF A 70 KT SWLY MID-LVL JET. HERE...INDIVIDUAL STORMS WILL BEGIN TO CROSS NW-SE ORIENTED WRMFNT WHERE LLVL SHEAR IS MAXIMIZED AND A BRIEF TORNADO IS POSSIBLE. AS SUCH...5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADDED. OTHERWISE...FCST IS ON TRACK ELSEWHERE. ..RACY.. 04/13/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1117 AM CDT TUE APR 13 2010/
